not_reproduced.tm-ferrocenium: D5h ferrocenium: the Hueckel pi system of each (antiaromatic, cationic) Cp ring has an exactly degenerate pair at the Fermi level, filled with integer occupations; its bond orders depend on which eigenvectors the eigensolver returns for the pair (xtb: MKL dsyev), so pi bond orders and the bond parameters built from them differ (xtb's are not rotation invariant either)
